profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | C++, C#, Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Unreal Engine, Unity
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer | Unreal & Unity | UI/UX | ML & Simulation Expert | C++

Results-oriented software engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying advanced interactive applications in gaming, simulation, and UI/UX. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, deliver scalable software solutions, and innovate with emerging technologies including LLMs and real-time 3D environments. Passionate about combining creativity and engineering to craft immersive digital experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed multiple LLMs to address complex client challenges, enhancing solution effectiveness.  
• Led the modernization of a large-scale Python application to a .NET Azure web application, integrating Microsoft Entra ID for improved security.  
• Developed and documented over 100 REST API endpoints, optimizing the React/HTML/CSS frontend for seamless integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · UI · .NET Framework · C# · React.js · Machine Learning · Omniverse · Microsoft Azure · HTML · CSS

positions.title: Layoff/position eliminated
positions.description:
- One of the many effected by Unity layoffs. 
- Currently working on a personal project within Unreal Engine.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Optimized gameplay features for the Buzz Games App using C# and Unity, enhancing performance and user experience.  
• Collaborated with designers to implement engaging UI/UX elements, significantly improving player interaction.  
• Streamlined code by removing redundancies, resulting in a cleaner and more maintainable codebase.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · Git · Game Development · Figma (Software) · User Experience (UX) · Teamwork · C# · Computer Science · Algorithms · Defining Requirements · Technical Engineering · HTML · CSS

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Core contributor on Minecraft’s Player Lifecycle Management team responsible for the Announcements and Inbox UX/UI Gameplay Feature. (React Frontend, C++ Backend)
- Refactored legacy systems in C++, improving performance, scalability, and code maintainability.
- Added Gif support to Minecraft.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Game Development · Figma (Software) · C++ · Code Review · User Experience (UX) · Teamwork · Video Games · React.js · Computer Science · Algorithms · JavaScript · Defining Requirements · Technical Engineering · Leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-authored, published and presented a ML research paper at I/ITSEC 2021 on Applied Object Detection and Semantic Segmentation.
- Worked on many Unreal Engine based simulations such as Voxel terrains and Procedural subway/sewer generation.
- Created local area networked multiplayer VR FPS in Unity, While leading R&D on motion sickness mitigation.
- Worked on a Java based Intelligent tutoring framework widely used by the Army.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to AR game development with dynamic terrain and real-time line-of-sight mechanics.
- Migrated ARL GIFT tutoring system to ITAAS for real-time training evaluation.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Built an EST2/FATS emulator for US Army marksmanship training.
- Presented project demos at I/ITSEC and internal showcases.

positions.title: C++ Programmer / Game Designer
positions.description:
- Designed core gameplay mechanics and revamped GUI for a new title.
- Refactored legacy code for improved maintainability and feature expansion.

publications.title: Augmenting OneWorld Terrain (OWT) Data with Civilian Infrastructure by Using Machine Learning Techniques
publications.publisher: Interservice/Industry Training, Simulation, and Education Conference (I/ITSEC) · Dec 1, 2021
